---
name: Feature Implementation Ticket
about: One scope-bounded engineering ticket generated by /tickets (Plan -> Contracts -> Ticket)
title: "[M<milestone>-SLICE-<nn>] "
labels: ["enhancement", "product-playbook"]
---

<!--
  ONE ticket = ONE concern = ONE pull request.
  VERTICAL slice   [M<n>-SLICE-<nn>] : one thin user-observable behaviour, crossing layers on purpose.
  HORIZONTAL slice [M<n>-TICK-<nn>]  : one architectural layer of one milestone.
  Ad-hoc           [ADHOC-<nn>]      : a bug, edge case, tech debt or security item found mid-build.
  If a reviewer would need a second concern to approve this, it is two tickets. Split it.
-->

### 🎯 Goal
<!-- The milestone this serves, and the one concern THIS ticket owns. For an ad-hoc issue: what happened, expected vs actual. -->

### 🧭 Slice Strategy
<!-- Exactly one. Recorded so a later reader knows why the backlog is shaped this way. -->
- [ ] ↕️ Vertical — thin end-to-end increment, demoable on merge
- [ ] ↔️ Horizontal — single architectural layer
- [ ] 🐛 Ad-hoc — bug · edge-case · tech-debt · security

<!-- Lane (next heading): the FEATURE this ticket belongs to, top to bottom ("checkout", "export"), never a technology
     layer ("backend", "ui"). Optional; Lanekeeper reads the text under the heading as the lane name and groups tickets
     that share it. Leave it empty to let Lanekeeper propose one from the Target Files. This comment sits ABOVE the
     heading so an empty field stays empty. -->
### 🛣️ Lane


### 🧱 Layer(s)
<!-- Horizontal: exactly one. Vertical: every layer this slice touches. -->
- [ ] 📦 Storage / data provider — schema models, persistence adapter, migration
- [ ] ⚙️ Pure domain service — business logic, state transitions, validation
- [ ] 🎨 UI component — isolated component, interactive states, a11y, `DESIGN.md` tokens
- [ ] 🧪 Cross-layer verification — integration across the real seam, adversarial/security

### 📁 Target Files
<!-- EXACT paths from STRUCTURE.md, one backticked path per line: a file such as src/services/quoteEngine.ts,
     never a bare folder such as src/services/. This list is the BOUNDARY: in lane mode it is what the merge
     gate enforces, so it must name everything the build will write, the feature doc and the test files included.
     Never list PRODUCT.md, CHANGELOG.md or STRUCTURE.md here: the spine is shared and reconciled by /dev-check + /ship.
     (No backticks inside this comment on purpose: Lanekeeper reads every backticked span under this heading as a path.) -->
- [ ] `path/to/file.ext`
- [ ] `docs/features/<feature>.md`

### 🔌 Contract — Inputs → Outputs
<!-- The typed shape this ticket consumes, and the one it exposes for dependants. Named from PRODUCT.md#Contracts. -->
- **Consumes:**
- **Exposes:**

### 🔗 Depends On
<!-- Ticket IDs whose CONTRACT this needs. Contracts land first, so this can start against a stub. "None" is a valid answer. -->

### 👀 Demo — what works after this merges
<!-- REQUIRED on a vertical slice. If the honest answer is "nothing visible yet", this is a layer, not a slice: re-slice it or move the milestone to horizontal. Horizontal tickets: state the seam a reviewer can exercise. -->

### 🛠️ Implementation Tasks
<!-- Ordered, checkable, inside THIS ticket's concern only. -->
- [ ] Task 1
- [ ] Task 2
- [ ] Task 3

### 🔒 Security in the Definition of Done
<!-- Mandatory. Every ticket carries its own security check. Never emit an "add security" ticket. -->
- [ ] Inputs validated against typed Zod schema at the seam
- [ ] Authentication / tenant-owner check on every data path (`userId`)
- [ ] Fail closed on unhandled errors (no swallowed exceptions)
- [ ] No secrets in source code or test fixtures
- [ ] Adversarial/security test written and passing

### 🧪 Verification Plan
<!-- Exact command to run and what to assert. -->
- **Automated tests:** `pnpm test`
- **Manual demo path:**
